football.title: Your football
football.intro: Pick the leagues and teams you follow: Home will show their matches first. We have ticked the most followed in Colombia.
football.introOlder: You can now pick your leagues and teams: Home will show their matches first. We have ticked the most followed in Colombia.
football.skipHelp: If you skip, you keep the ones suggested for Colombia. Change them any time in your profile.

about.title: What PrediGol is
about.analysis: Every day, the analysis of your matches: the forecast, the context and what each team plays for.
about.picks: Picks only when we measure an edge over the market's price. If no match has one, we publish nothing that day.
about.transparency: We tell you how we are doing, losses included.

hint.label: Tip
hint.picks: A pick comes out only when we measure an edge over the market's price. Tap any term to see what it means.
hint.match: The whole match is here: the forecast, the context, the market and, when there is one, the pick with its real state.
hint.parlay: In a parlay the odds multiply, and one selection that fails is enough to lose it.
hint.my_picks: Your saved picks settle with the official result; your figures count only those with a price.

tour.startHelp: Four steps through the essentials: Home, a match, a pick and My picks.

home.title: Home
home.body: It answers what is on today for you: your leagues first, the day's picks —or why there are none— and the results.

match.title: Match centre
match.body: Every match has its centre: the forecast, the context, the market and, once it is over, the post-match.

pick.title: A pick and its state
pick.body: In Picks you see each pick with its real state, from pending to settled, and why it met the conditions.

myPicks.title: My picks
myPicks.body: What you save settles by itself with the official result, and your figures come from there.
